g.text: CampusClaw Target Session Events Class Structure
It never freezes mutable Session state,
pending Tool state, or capacity admission.
Controller returns a response-specific immutable VO.
DTOs and persistence records never cross the API boundary.
Coordinate by Session, not by HTTP request or producer.
Check source order and committed prerequisites before append.
Recheck mutable state and dependencies in the owning transaction.
Allocate sequence and append atomically; keep the lock until commit.
No model calls, tool calls, or missing-dependency waits in the transaction.
Process-local locking alone is insufficient across service instances.
The class name and scheduling mechanism remain target-only suggestions.
One slow subscriber cannot block execution or other clients.
Overflow closes only this subscription and requires history repair.
